synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — net-cash self-funding balance sheet and rising absolute EBITDA against a real, management-confirmed North America demand and second-half visibility hit.

bull_points.claim: The de-rate is idiosyncratic, not shared: EPAM fell ~60% over 180d while the mid-cap benchmark rose ~12%, a ~72pp relative gap that points to a name-specific overshoot rather than a sector collapse.

Absolute EBITDA is still rising even as the margin % compressed — LTM EBITDA of $731M is an all-time high above FY25 $707M and FY24 $693M, so the falling 13% margin overstates deterioration when read against the growing dollar base.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: The balance sheet is net cash at net-debt/EBITDA -1.0x with LTM FCF of $692.9M, so the business is self-funding and faces no solvency-driven forced-sale dynamic.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt ÷ CIQ LTM EBITDA (EDGAR XBRL breadth fallback) + FCF sign (survival capacity)

bull_points.claim: Revenue is still growing, not declining: Q1 2026 grew 7.6% year-over-year with constant organic currency growth of 3.7% and 5 of 6 verticals up, inconsistent with a terminal secular-decline thesis.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: A new AI revenue leg is scaling with a mechanism behind it — pure AI revenues exceeded $125M in Q1 2026, up nearly 20% sequentially, tracking toward a stated $600M full-year target.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bull_points.claim: The company is buying back stock (share count -8.2% over ~1.7y) with net insider open-market buys (6 buys, 0 sells), signalling internal conviction rather than distress-selling.

The EV/EBITDA discount to peers (name 4.1x vs peer median 5.5x) is only partly earned: on the fundamental deltas EPAM's revenue growth (14% vs 1%) and leverage (Debt/EBITDA 0.4 vs 1.5) are FAVOURABLE, leaving open whether the discount is residual overshoot rather than a value trap — the offset is a lower EBITDA margin (13% vs 17%); heterogeneity (caps $734M–$77.7B, 106x) gates any clean read.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bear_points.claim: The gap-downs cluster on guidance events — the Feb-19-2026 earnings 8-K and the qualitative-only 2026 revenue outlook, with management flagging North America underperformance and lower second-half visibility, suggesting the de-rate is a real demand/visibility signal not pure sentiment.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: The forward revenue path is being cut across the board: next-2-FQ revenue breadth is overwhelmingly downward (FQ2 2026 1↑/14↓, FQ3 2026 0↑/14↓), a genuine load-bearing sign analysts expect deceleration.

Gross margin has structurally eroded from 36% (FY17) to 29% (LTM) and EBITDA margin from 17% peak to 13%, a multi-year quality decline that the rising absolute EBITDA only partly offsets — the margin trend is the REAL signal on unit economics, not an optical artefact.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: Return on capital has fallen from ~15% (FY22) to ~10% (LTM), a real erosion in capital efficiency that predates and underlies the price collapse.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Ratios (Return on Capital %, multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: Management itself frames tokenomics and AI pricing as a 'genuinely new and consequential commercial construct' with challenges, and larger AI deals carry longer sales cycles — an unresolved threat to the labour-arbitrage services model.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript: EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf

decisive_question.question: Is the second-half North America demand softness and AI-pricing disruption a temporary timing/visibility shift (overshoot) or the start of a structural erosion of EPAM's labour-based services model (value trap)?

evidence_for.claim: Management characterises the softness as 'a temporary shift in timing and direction' with client AI pipeline and funding 'remains strong' and an accelerating large-deal pipeline not yet in the outlook.

evidence_against.claim: Management explicitly cites North America underperformance and lower second-half visibility with added caution on larger discretionary programs, and 2026 revenue guidance was left qualitative-only.

evidence_against.claim: Forward revenue estimate breadth is near-uniformly downward (FQ3 2026 0↑/14↓), showing the analyst community does not yet see the softness as transient.

key_unknowns: Whether the 2026 revenue outlook is a raise, hold or cut is unknowable from the file — the 8-K EX-99.1 guidance is QUALITATIVE only (no number stated), a missing expected disclosure that is a bearish opacity risk.
No forward/adjusted EV/EBITDA or adjusted EPS is in the revised 99.1 guidance, so the trailing 4.9x multiple cannot be cleanly separated into cheap-overshoot vs cheap-terminal.
Segment-level EBITDA is UNKNOWN (Segments sheet has no EBITDA section), so profitability of Americas vs Europe — and where the North America weakness bites — cannot be isolated.
Interest coverage is UNKNOWN (no period with both EBITDA and interest expense), though net-cash status limits its importance.
The revolver matures October 2026 with a max leverage covenant of 3.50x; refinancing terms and covenant headroom on a company-adjusted basis are not disclosed.
The magnitude and durability of the AI 'tokenomics' pricing shift on the core services margin structure is unquantified — management flags it as consequential but unresolved.

business_description.value: EPAM Systems, Inc. provides digital platform engineering and software development services worldwide. The company offers engineering services, including requirements analysis and platform selection, customization, cross-platform migration, implementation, and integration; cloud services for creating a roadmap to set and refine IT and business goals while identifying new and emerging opportunities leveraging cloud technologies; data, analytics and artificial intelligence; customer experience; marketing; and cybersecurity. It also offers operation solutions comprising integrated engineering practices and smart automation services. In addition, the company offers software product and platform development services, which comprise product research, customer experience design and prototyping, program management, component design and integration, full lifecycle software testing, product deployment and end-user customization, performance tuning, product support and maintenance, managed services, as well as cross-platform migration and modernizing legacy platforms. The company serves the financial services; consumer goods, retail and travel; software and Hi-tech; business information and media, life sciences and healthcare; and emerging verticals industries EPAM Systems, Inc. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Newtown, Pennsylvania.
